**Goal:** one sentence.

**Inputs (link, don't paste):** specs, contracts, ADRs, decision IDs (D-___), open questions (Q___).

**Allowed to change:** exact files/directories. Nothing else.

**Must not touch:** files, schemas, dependencies.

**Acceptance criteria (testable):**

**Output format:** diff only | short summary | table.
